name: create-content
displayName: Create Model Mondays or AMA content
description: Creates source-backed Model Mondays episodes or independently numbered Foundry Friday AMAs.
rules: episode requires season and episode; ama requires amaNumber
episode page: YYYY-MM-DD-sNN-eNN.md; episode banner: S<season>-E<episode>.png
AMA page: YYYY-MM-DD-ama-NNN.md; AMA banner: AMA-NNN.png
verify the approved banner exists before creating content
never add placeholder headlines, URLs, speakers, biographies, or resources
update the matching JSON record and public index
